definitions: A commune in the Yvelines department in the Île-de-France region in north-central France.
A town known for its historical textile factory, the Manufacture royale de toiles de Jouy.
examples: The HEC Paris business school is located in Jouy-en-Josas.
The Toile de Jouy fabric originated in Jouy-en-Josas.
We visited Jouy-en-Josas during our trip to France.
